stage: blind independent second reading, saved before comparison

workflow.layout: Whole source viewed once for layout and attachments. All 21 saved crops were visually inspected. The page is upright; the prose and both diagrams did not require rotation.
workflow.preparation: prepare_second.py 089 was run once with no rotation. No crop was regenerated or replaced. One failed transport call for B011 displayed no image; the succeeding call displayed that crop.
workflow.comparison: No witnesses, first.tsv, first readings, drafts, approved pages, reports, root notes or decisions, hand log, other leaf, or comparison output opened. No comparison run.

content_summary: The page identifies a line of a referenced sequence with a sequence associated to a fiber over a residue field. It summarizes the curve, a codimension-one point, and a henselization, with corrections to the accompanying homomorphism wording. A rational section and its more general version lead to a section or lifting in a diagram, followed by a decomposition-group identification. This summarizes visible statements and does not verify them mathematically.

boxes.scope: Complete top handwritten number.
boxes.evidence: Two separate angular forms each have the descending diagonal, horizontal turn and lower stem of 4.

boxes.scope: Complete numbered formula, all connectors, both endpoint numerals.
boxes.evidence: The label is (27). The connectors after the first 1, after pi, and before the final 1 have plain shafts with small terminal deposits or hooks. Only the connector between the two E groups has a distinct two-sided arrowhead. The first group index has a narrow capital-like form and lower s; the second has k(s).
uncertainties: U is favored for the first group index, with N retained because the narrow lower turn and rising branch can support either. The larger U_s in B003 is a same-page stroke control, not a basis for supplying an unseen letter.
The plain shafts are represented as dashes, without converting them to arrows.

boxes.scope: Complete associé à U_s. The tiny fragment at the far right is part of punctuation outside the crop and is excluded.
boxes.evidence: Associé has two successive s hooks, a rounded o, c, dotted i and a separately raised accent at the ending. The accent on à is distinct. U has a rounded lower basin and right return, with small s at its lower right.

boxes.scope: Underlined heading and the next complete word La. The following word is clipped at the right edge.
boxes.evidence: Résumons has a raised accent on é and one separate underline spanning the word. The gap before La contains no separate full stop or colon.

boxes.scope: Complete parenthesis and its supralinear insertion.
boxes.evidence: The added word begins with a long descending p, followed by a small closed a and a low terminal s; it has its own short underline. A leader runs down toward the gap immediately after the opening parenthesis. Stricte and the closing parenthesis are complete.

boxes.scope: Altered parenthesized reference, comma, dont and la.
boxes.evidence: The 2 and parentheses are clear. The last digit has a strong upper horizontal, a dark downward stroke and overlapping rounded traces. A 5 is preferred as the later writing, but 6 remains possible. Dont ends with a raised, crossed t-like form; la follows.
uncertainties: The overwritten number is not securely recoverable. The TSV tentatively represents an underlying 6 and a later 5 or 6, both doubtful. These layers occupy one physical digit position, not two successive digits.
The whole broad-context crop B021 was also inspected; it supports retaining, not resolving, the digit uncertainty.

boxes.scope: Whole cancelled phrase and the replacement above it. Clipped ink from the preceding line at the top is excluded.
boxes.evidence: The live addition reads l'hom: looped l, separate apostrophe, tall h and low om, without a terminal point. A long horizontal cancellation crosses the older phrase. Its tall internal l and later dotted i support the tentative inclusion reading.
uncertainties: The cancelled l'inclusion remains doubtful because its low letters are merged with the strike.

boxes.scope: Supralinear phrase plus the complete principal word and colon. Upper-edge fragments from the preceding line are excluded.
boxes.evidence: Sur and pi with lower 1 are visible in the addition. The short intervening word has a tall l and low continuation. Correspondant has a descending p, tall d and terminal crossed t. Two separate vertically arranged marks follow.
uncertainties: The final low return of les does not establish a separate s conclusively, so le is retained as an alternative.
The upper member of the final punctuation is elongated, but its separate lower dot supports the colon reading.

boxes.scope: The entire four-node diagram and its closing parenthesis at upper right.
boxes.evidence: Top nodes are U_s and U with a lower O carrying a tilde. The right vertical and lower horizontal connectors have distinct arrowheads. The top shaft and left vertical have small end traces without unequivocal two-wing heads. Bottom right reads Spec with a tilde-bearing O. The lower-left label is dark and retraced.
uncertainties: The lower-left label is provisionally s.
The top and left connectors remain headless in the transcription; a very small barb cannot be ruled out at their ends.
The closing parenthesis stands spatially to the right of the upper row; its position after the TeX diagram is a layout approximation.

boxes.scope: Clipped suffix lle, the inserted f and adjacent obscure mark, its leader, and complete de.
boxes.evidence: The f has a long curved stem, crossbar and lower hook. Immediately to its right are several overdrawn oblique and looped traces. A separate slanting leader descends to the gap before de.
uncertainties: The mark after f cannot be identified securely. Cancellation is favored but not certain, so both cancelled and live states remain explicit.
The question marks in the TSV are editorial placeholders for that unidentified mathematical mark; no authored question mark is asserted.
The missing start of the word ending lle is not supplied.

boxes.scope: Principal fragment from plus through sur, including the inserted tilde-f. Sur approaches the right crop boundary.
boxes.evidence: Plus is followed by gén. with a separate accent and terminal stop. The added f has an independent tilde and a leader to the gap before de. The following U has a lower O with its own tilde.
uncertainties: The final return of sur is clipped slightly by the right boundary, but its reading is supported by the visible preceding letters.

boxes.scope: Whole principal line and the inserted indexed symbol. Clipped descenders from the preceding line are excluded.
boxes.evidence: Section precedes the addition, whose leader enters before de. The added main glyph has two open curved members; f is lower and has a separate tilde above it. De la ligne médiane de (26), is visible, including the comma.
uncertainties: The small main glyph can be represented as epsilon or calligraphic E; its case and identity are not settled by its size alone. Both are retained, without deriving a preferred symbol from the mathematical role.

boxes.scope: Complete principal line.
boxes.evidence: Ou ce qui revient au is legible. The following short form has two independent straight horizontal members, with no separate letter humps. Un relèvement follows; the accent and tall l are visible. No final punctuation is established.

boxes.scope: The entire diagram, arrow label, lower node, vertical connector and handwritten label (28).
boxes.evidence: The left node has E with a tilde-bearing K index. A horizontal right arrow is labelled lambda and ends at E with the nested index U, tilde-O. A lower E with U_s is heavily retraced. Between the two right nodes is a short vertical straight stroke and an adjacent curved member.
uncertainties: The vertical connector may be a rotated simeq with the straight member on the left and curved member on the right, or an upward arrow with a cramped adjacent trace. Both are preserved.
The lower E has extra rounded retracing, but no specific earlier glyph or separate deletion is securely recoverable; its reading remains doubtful.

boxes.scope: Complete de and following parenthesized map expression. The clipped fragment from the upper diagram is excluded.
boxes.evidence: E with tilde-K maps by a clear right arrow to E with tilde-O. In parentheses, an explicit left arrow has a separate tilde above it and precedes E with an indexed k(s)-like expression. Both parentheses are visible.
uncertainties: The indexed k has strong angular arms and could be capital K; both cases are retained.

boxes.scope: Complete group symbol and the following visible words.
boxes.evidence: The E index has a separate tilde and a narrow angular capital-like letter. The next word begins with a descending stem and loop, has a long low middle, and a compact raised ending. D'ailleurs has a tall d, detached apostrophe-like mark, dotted i and two l stems.
uncertainties: K is preferred for the indexed letter but N remains possible from the narrow joint.
The short word before d'ailleurs remains doubtful: qui is preferred, par is retained, and the faint low joins do not conclusively exclude a pour-like form.

boxes.scope: Complete principal fragment; clipped next-line fragments along the bottom are excluded.
boxes.evidence: S'identifie has visible apostrophe and i dots, followed by au groupe de. The long lower loop belongs to g in groupe.

boxes.scope: Whole indexed and underlined symbol. The fragment of the preceding word at the left edge is clipped context and excluded.
boxes.evidence: The main oval has a large top opening but a rounded right side and an independent underline. Its first lower index is a large retraced S, followed by a separate comma and a smaller s.
uncertainties: O is favored for the main letter; U remains possible because the upper opening is wide. The underline and both indices are retained independently of that doubt.

boxes.scope: Complete lower-left handwritten number.
boxes.evidence: Both figures have two loops and read 8, giving 88.

boxes.scope: Complete opening line and the separate à on the following line.
boxes.evidence: La dernière ligne dans (26) s'identifie aussi is legible; the reference has a clear 2 and 6. The next-line à has its own detached accent. No punctuation is supplied between these fragments.

boxes.scope: All five principal lines in the broad correction context, including the heading, numerals, correction layers and the open parenthetical phrase.
boxes.evidence: The heading is singly underlined without a following stop. The text reads La situation de la courbe relative U/S, et d'un s in S de codim 1, then the henselization clause with inserted underlined pas. The following line contains the altered reference and dont la dernière ligne. The bottom line has literal abbreviations can. and isom., the clear reference (27), and the cancelled/replaced phrase also shown in B007.
uncertainties: The accent on the first e of définit is not independently secure at this scale; accented and unaccented readings are retained.
The changed reference and cancelled l'inclusion retain the uncertainties recorded in B006 and B007.
The opening parenthesis before par remains open within this box; its continuation lies outside the crop.
